run_rerank_score_bw_cli: run the rerank_score_bw CLI module to score translations using a backwards model for noisy channel reranking
run_score_bw_function: run the score_bw function to score hypothesis translations with one or two scoring models
run_backwards_scoring_model1: run backwards scoring on translations using model 1 by setting the backwards1 flag and language directions
run_backwards_scoring_model2: run backwards scoring on translations using model 2 by setting the backwards2 flag and language directions
run_rescore_with_prefix_options: run rescoring with target or source prefix fractions to score partial translations for reranking
